o.en: Display a list of all available locales. The -v option causes the LC_IDENTIFICATION metadata about each locale to be included in the output.
Display the available charmaps (character set description files). To display the current character set for the locale, use locale -c charmap.

For a category name argument, write the name of the locale category on a separate line preceding the list of keyword values for that category. For a keyword name argument, write the name of the locale category for this keyword on a separate line preceding the keyword value.
For each keyword whose value is being displayed, include also the name of that keyword, so that the output has the format: keyword="value"
Display additional information for some command-line option and argument combinations.
Display a short usage message and exit.
Display the program version and exit.
